subject: Redwood x Northbridge: Joint POC + AWS Private Offer onboarding
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Eleanor Price <eleanor.price@northbridge.consulting>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 May 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood x Northbridge: Joint POC + AWS Private Offer onboarding

Hi Eleanor — great to reconnect. Thanks again for the intro call yesterday. Northbridge's idea to validate an embedded LLM workflow for your retail client aligns nicely with what our Dedicated offering shines on (predictable throughput + private tenancy).

Quick proposal to get moving:
- Run a 4-week joint POC focusing on a retrieval-augmented generation flow integrated with Northbridge's middleware.
- Host inference via a Dedicated pool in us-west-2; front the customer through an AWS Private Offer so procurement can buy directly from your SOW.
- Deliverables: integration runbook, performance baseline (p50/p95), ramp checklist, and a short handoff workshop for the customer's SREs.

I'm attaching a short performance sheet and an initial SOW draft to speed reviews. Can you confirm the customer's procurement timeline and whether Northbridge wants to handle the Private Offer paperwork or have Redwood engage your AWS AM directly?

Next steps I propose:
1) Confirm POC scope and timeline (we're aiming to kickoff week of 5/27)
2) Align on procurement owner (Northbridge / Customer / Redwood)
3) Collect security evidence requests (SOC2, data residency, KMS)

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick sync if that's easier.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- redwood-dedicated-performance-sheet.pdf (PDF)
- northbridge-sow-draft.docx (DOCX)
From: Eleanor Price <eleanor.price@northbridge.consulting>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Kapoor <samir.kapoor@northbridge.consulting>, Alyssa Wu <alyssa.wu@amazon.com>
Date: Fri, 17 May 2029 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood x Northbridge: Joint POC + AWS Private Offer onboarding

Ben — this looks great, thanks. Samir and I reviewed your notes internally. A few quick items from our side:

- Procurement: the end customer prefers to buy via an AWS Private Offer; Northbridge will initiate the PO but we'd like Redwood's assistance with the AWS listing SKU and line-item mapping so procurement sees a clean chargeback.
- Timeline: the customer procurement lead suggested approvals by 6/10, so kickoff the last week of May should work if legal and finance turn around the SOW this week.
- Security evidence: they asked for SOC 2 Type II summary, a short note on KMS integration and key custody, and confirmation of retention window for inference logs.

Looping in Alyssa from AWS — Alyssa, can you confirm whether an existing marketplace listing is needed for Private Offer ingestion or if a direct SKU mapping from the Private Offer console is sufficient? Also any guidance on lead times for a Private Offer in us-west-2 would be helpful.

Samir, please see the attached SOW and mark any scope edits.

Best,
Eleanor
Eleanor Price
Senior Partner, Northbridge Consulting

Thanks Ben — added a couple internal notes. Monica will lead the implementation/runbook side and Priyom will own the billing/metering mapping for the Private Offer.

Monica, can you review the performance sheet and call out any dependencies we need (VPC peering, PrivateLink, or a managed connector)? Ben — tentative kickoff for 5/28 (60 min) looks good to me; please lock a meeting if Northbridge confirms the PO timeline.

Team — updated SOW attached with language to reflect a 4-week phased POC (Discovery, Integration, Performance Tuning, Handoff). Two notes:

1) Billing flow: customer procurement prefers the Private Offer to appear as a single line item mapped to "Northbridge Consulting / Redwood Inference — POC Credits". We understand AWS can create a Private Offer using an existing listing SKU and map a custom price. Alyssa — can you confirm this is the typical flow?

2) AWS evidence & docs: attached a short diagram showing how Northbridge expects to stitch the integration (see aws-private-offer-billing-flow.png). We also need a short technical blurb confirming Redwood's retention policy for inference logs during POC and whether we can configure a 30-day retention window.

Attachments:
- northbridge-sow-draft.docx (updated)

Happy to hop on a 30-minute call tomorrow if that helps unblock procurement.

- We can support a 30-day retention window for inference logs during the POC; Monica will share the minimal configuration steps and IAM roles we need from the customer.
- For billing: Private Offer mapped to an existing Redwood SKU is ideal. Priyom, I'll defer to you for the exact SKU string but agree that having AWS create the Private Offer that invoices through the customer's AWS account is the lowest friction path.
- I'll draft a short kick-off agenda and lock 5/28 10:00am PT for a 60-minute kickoff unless someone flags a conflict.

Quick call to finalize procurement details tomorrow AM?

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.
